column6: Goodberry: a berry eaten, a small green healing light.
Antilife Shell: the shell JB2A drew for this exact spell.
Antimagic Field: a grey sphere where magic stops.
Aura of Life: a green aura held around the caster.
Aura of Purity: a clean gold aura around the caster.
Aura of Vitality: healing light held over the aura.
A smite in force violet — one of seven smites, all built on the divine smite strike.
Barkskin: bark closes over the skin. Its own effect already has an FX; this is the cast.
A smite in blinding white.
Blur: the outline goes soft.
A conjuration circle at the caster, as Conjure Animals already reads.
Conjure Woodland Beings: nature spirits flit round the caster.
Crown of Madness: an enchantment circle in red at the target.
Crusader's Mantle: a gold aura around the crusader.
The detection circle at the caster, in gold.
Detect Magic: the circle JB2A and PSFX both drew for this exact spell.
The detection circle at the caster, in green.
Fire Shield: fire held around the caster. The cold version is the blue variant of the same asset.
Fount of Moonlight: cold moonlight around the caster.
Heal: the big healing light — Cure Wounds, at sixth level.
Holy Aura: gold light held over the warded.
A storm of light and thunder in the template.
Lesser Restoration: a clean green light at the target.
The detection circle, in green, seeking the wild.
The detection circle, seeking a thing.
Healing Word on everyone in range — the same light, at each target.
Suggestion on many: an enchantment circle at each target.
A false aura laid over the subject.
Pass without Trace: the party goes quiet and dim.
Protection from Energy: the same shield the five elemental protections already use.
Resistance: a small blue shield at the target.
A smite in fire orange.
Shield: the barrier snaps up. PSFX drew intro, loop and outro for this exact spell.
Shield of Faith: a gold shield held at the target.
A smite that leaves the target lit.
Spirit Guardians: the spirits JB2A drew for this exact spell, in eleven colours.
A smite in psychic violet.
Steel Wind Strike: a flash of cuts across every target.
Stoneskin: stone closes over the skin. Its own effect already has an FX; this is the cast.
A smite that lands with thunder.
Polymorph's circle, at ninth level.
Raise Dead's circle, at ninth level.
A smite in necrotic red.
A pulse of regal presence pushes outward from the caster.
